## FX Index Dashboard – End of Round 3

The FX Index tracks how each currency is performing in the market (in alphabetical order).

::: {.callout-note}
**How to read this table:** Higher scores indicate strengthening / inflows. Lower scores indicate depreciation pressure / outflows.
:::

| Country | FX Index | Status | Notes |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Agrona | 100.9 | Stable / improving | Tightening, austerity, and strategic-goods negotiations reduced earlier market concerns. |
| Atlantica | 102.0 | Stable / strengthening | Indirect intervention aimed at stabilization, combined with open trade and credibility, reinforced Atlantica’s anchor role. |
| Frontieria | 101.1 | Stable | Restricted capital and indirect stabilization measures preserved the gains made in earlier rounds. |
| Industralia | 101.7 | Stable / strengthening | Markets responded positively to its cooperative stance and wider trade framework. |
| Mercatoria | 101.2 | Stable / strengthening | Trade diplomacy and indirect intervention improved sentiment while its managed capital system limited volatility. |
| Noravia | 101.9 | Stable / strengthening | Tight monetary policy and strategic-goods diplomacy supported the currency despite fiscal stimulus. |
| Pacifica | 101.6 | Stable / strengthening | Direct support for the currency and multilateral trade outreach produced one of the strongest gains this round. |
| Petrovia | 101.1 | Stable | Bilateral outreach with Agrona modestly improved sentiment in a still resource-sensitive economy. | |

::: {.callout-important}
**Reminder:** The FX Index is a summary indicator. Your job is to submit a coherent policy package that restores confidence or adjusts the regime when conditions change.
:::

## How to Interpret the FX Index

| FX Index Range | Market Label | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 115–105 | Strengthening | Capital inflows and appreciation pressure |
| 104–97 | Stable | Normal market conditions |
| 96–90 | Softening | Mild depreciation pressure |
| 89–80 | Under Pressure | Visible stress and market testing |
| 79–70 | Severe Pressure | Strong outflows or reserve loss |
| < 70 | Crisis | Devaluation or regime change likely |

::: {.callout-important}
Your goal is not to “maximize” the FX Index every week. Your goal is to choose a **coherent** policy mix that supports your country’s objectives while maintaining credibility.
:::
